title: Notification center
idea: Notification center: Recent actionable events group by actual resource or consequence, keeping read state separate from resolved work.
audience: People who need to review notifications within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: Notifications lead to different real tasks.
avoidWhen: A notification count would imply recipient delivery or task completion.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its review notifications priority and explicit commitment contract: Marking an event read does not mark its underlying action complete.
navigation: Notification center keeps the current review notifications context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Recent actionable events group by actual resource or consequence, keeping read state separate from resolved work.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to review notifications; notifications lead to different real tasks.
composition.priority: Marking an event read does not mark its underlying action complete.

imagery.role: Support the actual review notifications context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use resource-grouped rows and accessible read/unread actions.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the notification center structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no review notifications content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Marking an event read does not mark its underlying action complete.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized review notifications content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Marking an event read does not mark its underlying action complete.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active review notifications context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
